16.en: What you ask of me, challenges my oaths to the choir and this damnable house. But I cannot ignore the things I’ve seen here. Nethecaré thinks I’m disposable. They’ll consider it a betrayal if they find out I’ve been talking to you. If that happens, I know what fate awaits me at the Emperor’s table. So, I will assuredly take you down with me

28.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.4neMMGpoX4oC0yOt]{Mizo Leskar} is an exceptional psyker and former choir member of Hive @UUID[Compendium.impmal-starter-set.journals.JournalEntry.Vjfxkwi1rFYPnSIf]{Rokarth}’s @UUID[Compendium.impmal-starter-set.journals.JournalEntry.Vjfxkwi1rFYPnSIf.JournalEntryPage.lydNVBL1CeXU15kz#the-crystalline-reflectory]{Crystalline Reflectory}. At the behest of @UUID[Compendium.impmal-starter-set.journals.JournalEntry.Vjfxkwi1rFYPnSIf.JournalEntryPage.Dml6BI69jLrNOQU0#castyx]{House Castyx}, they were seconded to @UUID[Compendium.impmal-starter-set.journals.JournalEntry.Vjfxkwi1rFYPnSIf.JournalEntryPage.Dml6BI69jLrNOQU0#nethecare]{House Nethecaré} as the personal astropath of the house’s inner circle. Whilst Mizo enjoys the sense of individuality and newfound relative peace operating outside the psychic choir, they detest the house they are now bound to. Never have they been privy to so many terrible secrets all at once.

32.en: Yet @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.4neMMGpoX4oC0yOt]{Mizo} is duty-bound to comply with the house’s requests. The psyker is caught between representing the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.6hX0E9XlPUoRaDaQ.JournalEntryPage.upGG1JZPDbC7dpJJ]{Adeptus Astra Telepathica}, the direct orders of Planetary Governor @UUID[Compendium.impmal-starter-set.journals.JournalEntry.Vjfxkwi1rFYPnSIf.JournalEntryPage.Dml6BI69jLrNOQU0#castyx]{Castyx}, and the most influential members of @UUID[Compendium.impmal-starter-set.journals.JournalEntry.Vjfxkwi1rFYPnSIf.JournalEntryPage.Dml6BI69jLrNOQU0#nethecare]{House Nethecaré}. Mizo spends their time between Hive Dalal and the Brass Hive on @UUID[Compendium.impmal-starter-set.journals.JournalEntry.Vjfxkwi1rFYPnSIf]{Rokarth}, carted about unceremoniously at the house’s behest. The chorister knows this position is impossible to escape but wishes dearly to serve a more pious master.

36.en: Mizo is a flexible contact; should the characters require an astropath Contact on a planet other than @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.59y8WFXTbwKRwiRI]{Voll}, Mizo can be placed in another planetary governor’s court. With their Divination powers, it is plausible for Mizo to seek the characters out on Voll and make contact on their own.

54.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.4neMMGpoX4oC0yOt]{Mizo} has learned that a member of @UUID[Compendium.impmal-starter-set.journals.JournalEntry.Vjfxkwi1rFYPnSIf.JournalEntryPage.Dml6BI69jLrNOQU0#nethecare]{House Nethecaré’s} inner circle, Brynna Molsk, is secretly a rogue psyker. Not as powerful as Leskar by any means, Brynna has avoided detection by authorities for her entire life, yet she suspects that Mizo now knows of her hidden curse. Her presence disrupts Mizo’s abilities, like a constant buzzing in their ears. Mizo wants to get rid of her but is unable to do so.

62.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.4neMMGpoX4oC0yOt]{Mizo} believes that someone is plotting to assassinate @UUID[Compendium.impmal-starter-set.journals.JournalEntry.Vjfxkwi1rFYPnSIf.JournalEntryPage.Dml6BI69jLrNOQU0#castyx]{Planetary Governor Castyx}. They catch fleeting images in their visions of a strange spined snake coiling around the Governor’s neck and dark figures taking over the Governor’s court. Mizo is unsure what to do with this information. If they were to report this to superiors in @UUID[Compendium.impmal-starter-set.journals.JournalEntry.Vjfxkwi1rFYPnSIf.JournalEntryPage.Dml6BI69jLrNOQU0#nethecare]{House Nethecaré}, they are sure these warnings would land on deaf ears; Mizo thinks they could be involved.

78.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.4neMMGpoX4oC0yOt]{Mizo} has snippets of @UUID[Compendium.impmal-starter-set.journals.JournalEntry.Vjfxkwi1rFYPnSIf.JournalEntryPage.Dml6BI69jLrNOQU0#nethecare]{House Nethecaré’s} most profound secrets in their mind and has slowly been piecing them together. The house goes against @UUID[Compendium.impmal-starter-set.journals.JournalEntry.Vjfxkwi1rFYPnSIf.JournalEntryPage.Dml6BI69jLrNOQU0#castyx]{Lord Castyx’s} decree to share all the research they find in @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.59y8WFXTbwKRwiRI]{Voll’s} acid wastes and their experimentations into psychic abilities go far beyond their remit. They are secretly working with an @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.brh2O5CexxurRbM7.JournalEntryPage.YFKg8L1rfWbScqkr#ordo-xenos]{Ordo Xenos} Inquisitor. They have detected a hidden psychic presence on Voll and kept it a secret (this could point to the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.FNEW8e33IisZh27W.JournalEntryPage.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald's Howl} being present on Voll or psychic-capable strains of the acynadi they harvest).

86.en: It is rare for anyone in the Imperium to have a personal astropath in their pocket. If the characters gain the heights of @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.4neMMGpoX4oC0yOt]{Mizo}’s trust, they will find the time to send psychic messages on behalf of the party — significantly reducing the time it takes them to contact entities outside the system.
